datasets.title: Malawi Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 3.0 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 46% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 4 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 2% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['building'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en building building:levels building:materials addr:full addr:housenumber addr:street addr:city office source name:ny This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap as volunteered geographic information and exported by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage). The dataset represents approximately 3.0 million mapped buildings with metadata on data currency and completeness estimates.
